title: Marryandbride collection feature
description: A half-and-half collection spread: one tall 4:5 photo fills half the width; the other half holds two product tiles at the top and, at the bottom, a serif title, a short sans paragraph and an underlined uppercase 'discover' link, inset generously from the middle. Mirror it with `reverse`. On phones: the photo, then the text, then the two tiles side by side.
notes: stack two with reverse on the second for the original's zig-zag
photo slot 4:5 on desktop (a little wider than square on phones); tiles are 2:3
